items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: As I’m looking at your list of people you’ve played with, it goes from Joan Rivers to Cab Calloway

ctx.x: You’re welcome. As I’m looking at your list of people you’ve played with, it goes from Joan Rivers to Cab Calloway, to Darius Brubeck, and I’m thinking of the term “journeyman drummer.” Do you call yourself a journeyman drummer?

I call myself versatile. I call myself versatile. Yes. And I play any style and thus, I like to, it helps with my discipline, playing the shows, and I use that discipline in my jazz playing. So I’m a versatile player, I play all styles, and I enjoy that, it keeps me fresh, and I kind of steal from each one of those styles and institute it in my jazz playing.
